protocol.benchmark_outputs: new directories only; preserve raw witnesses, process state, stdout, stderr and hashes

common_scope_exceptions.IMO_2010_P2: User approved 0 < tf < 1; exclude original endpoint configurations on both sides (2026-08-31)
common_scope_exceptions.IMO_2014_P4: Both inputs already use interior points P,Q; do not claim coverage of original closed-side boundary configurations

protocol.completed_process_vs_first_output: A timely native-accepted, independently valid emitted witness counts for the first-output metric even if the process later times out or crashes; completion status is reported separately
protocol.evidence_integrity: Affinity violations, surviving owned descendants, observation errors and inconsistent or missing emission identity are not primary successes; report these as evidence issues, not geometry failures
protocol.execution_order: GeoSolver: seed 0 then 1 then 2, case ID order within each seed; then aligned GMB cases in the same seed-major order
protocol.existing_gmb_artifacts: immutable; common-checker reassessment is a separate later step
protocol.goals: secondary diagnostics on the first valid configuration; never search feedback
protocol.legacy_gmb_reuse: Reuse immutable seed 0/1/2 raw for 34 unchanged official inputs; run each of the two aligned inputs anew at all three seeds
protocol.main_run_authorization_text: ではこの固定されたsolverを使って、GMBとの比較評価を行いたいです（/home/kabatan/work/solver/JSSA_2026_REPORT_AND_EXPERIMENT_PLAN.mdで計画されていたように）以前比較実験を途中までやったときと同じように進めて貰えばいいのですが、できますか？
protocol.main_run_gate: A fresh passing synthetic canary, approved static input audit and hash-bound campaign manifest are required; no natural-case retry or outcome-dependent edits
protocol.modified_case_prior_outcomes: Existing GMB outcomes for the two modified inputs are not replacement runs for the aligned inputs
protocol.normalization: Remove translation, rotation and positive scale only; retain shape freedoms
protocol.official_replication_and_aligned_compari: Different input profiles; do not relabel or combine their outcomes as the same experiment
protocol.previous_geosolver_outcomes: Preserve the incomplete earlier-version campaign; do not resume or pool its outcomes with solver-a1.
protocol.primary_acceptance: native accepted output passes common GMBL checker and independent original-condition coverage is approved
protocol.primary_question: Find one nondegenerate configuration satisfying the original assumptions
protocol.source_discrepancies: Use original mathematical assumptions; preserve official GMB inputs and explicitly label the two separately repaired comparison inputs

timing.existing_gmb_time_field: model_materialized event elapsed_seconds (after its atomic witness write)
timing.geosolver_primary_observation_point: accepted_candidates at finite exact assembly return, after native acceptance
timing.improved_revision: new coordinates always receive a new materialization time
timing.includes: imports, public-input validation, output materialization and instrumentation
timing.instrumentation_parity_gate: synthetic canary must pass before any natural-case run
timing.materialized_seconds: intermediate computation timestamp only; never the primary emitted-witness time
timing.not_measured: earliest unexported float iterate or earliest acceptance inside an unfinished batch
timing.offline_checker_time: reported separately; not added to search time
timing.origin: parent monotonic clock immediately before spawning the fresh worker
timing.primary: time to first emitted witness passing independent checks; measured after atomic witness write

protocol.tolerance_selection: synthetic fixtures only; no saved GMB configurations inspected
protocol.unaccepted_internal_candidates: diagnostics only, never primary successes against GMB's native accepted models
protocol.unresolved_or_unsupported_check: not a success; preserve the reason
